title: Investigations
description: Pump anomaly scores and vibration, and the agent's findings: one investigation per device and alert window, stored in InfluxDB as agent_investigation.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "inference", start: -30d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "inference", start: -30d)

panels.title: Anomaly score
panels.description: Highest anomaly_score per window from inference/<device>/result. Above the dashed line (ANOMALY_THRESHOLD) Node-RED raises an alert.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inference" and r._field == "anomaly_score" and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r.sensor == "vibration" and r._field == "value" and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device"])

panels.title: Investigations
panels.description: Findings the agent published on agent/investigations/<device>, newest first. status failed: no finding (timeout or model error); see summary.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "agent_investigation" and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "device", "status"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "status", "cause", "confidence", "summary", "duration_ms", "incident"])
